title: Ciliary IFT88 inhibits intervertebral disc degeneration under excessive mechanical stress by regulating endplate cartilage calcification.
authors: Dong, Zhi-Rui; Wang, Jing; Huang, Yu-Kai; Ding, Wang; He, Huan-Xin; Yuan, Guang-Cheng; Gao, Zhi-Yang; Ge, Yu-Xiang; Wang, Wen-Xian; Jiang, Li-Bo; Zhao, Ming-Dong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IFT88在椎间盘退变中调控终板软骨钙化的机制，属于细胞信号与疾病病理研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Endplate cartilage is crucial for nutrient transport to intervertebral disc (IVD), and its calcification due to abnormal mechanical stress significantly contributes to intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD). Primary cilia, which sense mechanical stimuli, are key to this process. Intraflagellar Transport 88 (IFT88) regulates endplate calcification under mechanical stress, but its specific mechanisms remain inadequately characterized. OBJECTIVES: We aimed to elucidate the role and regulatory mechanisms of IFT88 in primary cilia in endplate cartilage calcification and IVD. METHODS: Changes in IFT88 expression in endplate cartilage and its response to mechanical stress were assessed using histochemical staining, Western blotting, immunofluorescence, and transmission electron microscopy. The relationship between abnormal stress and calcium ions was explored through RNA sequencing, qPCR, and calcium staining. In vitro studies investigated the regulatory mechanisms of IFT88 in chondrocytes subjected to abnormal stress using molecular docking, co-immunoprecipitation, dual-luciferase assays, and flow cytometry. Rats tail crush model confirmed the role of IFT88 in chondral calcification and IDD as a potential therapeutic target. RESULTS: As intervertebral disc degeneration progresses, IFT88 expression in the primary cilia of cartilage endplate cells decreased. Under normal stress conditions, IFT88 levels increased with the intensity and duration of stress; however, excessively high stress triggered mechanisms that led to cilia depletion. Elevated intracellular calcium concentrations under tensile stress contributed to endplate calcification and IDD. Additionally, IFT88 negatively regulated its positive transcription factor C/EBPalpha under abnormal stress, potentially contributing to cilia depletion. IFT88 also inhibited the hyperactivation of transient receptor potential vanilloid 4 (TRPV4), reducing calcium influx and alleviating oxidative stress and Wnt pathway activation. In vivo studies showed that overexpressing IFT88 maintains disc height and structural integrity while reducing endplate ossification. CONCLUSION: Our study demonstrates that IFT88 inhibits TRPV4, thereby protecting endplate cartilage and positioning IFT88 as a promising therapeutic target for IDD and endplate calcification.
abstract_zh: 引言：终板软骨对于营养物质向椎间盘（IVD）的转运至关重要，而异常机械应力导致的终板软骨钙化显著促进椎间盘退变（IDD）。初级纤毛作为机械刺激的感受器，在此过程中发挥关键作用。鞭毛内转运蛋白88（IFT88）在机械应力下调节终板钙化，但其具体机制尚未充分阐明。目的：我们旨在阐明IFT88在初级纤毛中对终板软骨钙化和椎间盘退变的作用及其调控机制。方法：通过组织化学染色、Western blotting、免疫荧光和透射电子显微镜评估终板软骨中IFT88表达的变化及其对机械应力的响应。通过RNA测序、qPCR和钙染色探讨异常应力与钙离子之间的关系。体外研究利用分子对接、免疫共沉淀、双荧光素酶报告基因实验和流式细胞术，探讨异常应力下软骨细胞中IFT88的调控机制。大鼠尾椎挤压模型证实了IFT88在软骨钙化和椎间盘退变中作为潜在治疗靶点的作用。结果：随着椎间盘退变的进展，软骨终板细胞初级纤毛中IFT88表达下降。在正常应力条件下，IFT88水平随应力强度和持续时间增加而升高；然而，过高的应力触发导致纤毛耗竭的机制。拉伸应力下细胞内钙离子浓度升高，促进终板钙化和椎间盘退变。此外，IFT88在异常应力下负调控其正向转录因子C/EBPalpha，可能促进纤毛耗竭。IFT88还抑制瞬时受体电位香草酸亚型4（TRPV4）的过度激活，减少钙内流，并缓解氧化应激和Wnt通路激活。体内研究表明，过表达IFT88可维持椎间盘高度和结构完整性，同时减少终板骨化。结论：我们的研究表明，IFT88抑制TRPV4，从而保护终板软骨，并将IFT88定位为椎间盘退变和终板钙化的有前景的治疗靶点。
